primary_metric: Paired log loss against the same-book market, equal fixture weighting; paper ROI is secondary
history_cutoff: Strictly before the UTC quote-capture day, never match day; rates frozen at capture
scope: ATP BO3, all surfaces including indoor and qualifying; exact same-time Grosvenor winner and games contracts
selection: First verified pre-match fixture batch, up to one selection per arm per market; main line else closest proportional no-vig 50%, deterministic line/offer-ID tie-break. Missing inputs and no-bets remain locked for that fixture

review.precision: Report fixture-cluster paired log-loss 95% interval and paper ROI uncertainty. Manual review only; no profitability claim when interval includes zero or fewer than 100 independent fixtures.
review.harm: At a decision review, an entirely positive candidate-minus-reference log-loss interval requires manual stop review. No retuning, scope rescue, automatic promotion or extension to chase significance.

historical_status: Original research INCONCLUSIVE; original A/B gates failed and remain unchanged. New prospective exploratory registration.
